newsitem.title: USA: Innovex still sees sequential EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Innovex still sees sequential EPS growth.

text.p: Innovex Inc said it expects to post fiscal third quarter revenues and earnings higher than in the second quarter, despite the cancellation of some orders.

Innovex said Read-Rite Corp cancelled some orders to be delivered during its fiscal third quarter ending June 30. But the company said at the same time it received increased orders from other companies.

"After an analysis of the net effect of these changes on scheduled deliveries for the third quarter, we see no reason to revise our revenue or earnings projections for that quarter, or for the fiscal year," Thomas Haley, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement. "To the contrary, Innovex continues to expect sequential growth in both revenues and earnings over the quarter ended March 31, 1997."
Innovex reported earnings of $0.66 a share for its fiscal second quarter on revenues of $38.39 million.

According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates is for third quarter earnings of $0.72 a share, versus $0.25 a share last year. Analysts expect on average earnings of $2.30 a share for the year.
Haley said the company also expects third quarter margins will equal or exceed historical margins.
Innovex manufactures electrical components for the computer electronics and medical instruments markets. It also develops computer software.
